human-centric.definition: A philosophical approach emphasizing the alignment of artificial intelligence and web technology with human needs, usability, and ethical values over strict structural engineering.

edge-autonomy.definition: The capability of a user to act as their own platform provider natively on an edge device (such as a mobile phone), utilizing local-first data storage.

knowledge-bank.definition: A localized, user-operated repository of personal data and computational context, designed to operate independently of always-on server requirements.
